description: A structural containment relationship between two anatomical terms: an assertion that one Anatomy structure is a structural part of another, encoding anatomical containment from Uberon. The edge is directed from the part to the whole; a single anatomical term may be a part of several wholes. Both endpoints are Anatomy nodes. This is distinct from the subtype hierarchy (ISA_AiA): `part_of` is about physical composition, not classification.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: The data sources that assert this edge. Always ["uberon"], since this relationship is sourced exclusively from Uberon.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: When this edge was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: `part_of` (structural containment) relationships between non-obsolete anatomical terms in the Uberon basic anatomy ontology. An edge exists only where both the part and whole terms are present in SPOKE as Anatomy nodes; relationships pointing at an obsolete or absent term are not represented.
source_contributions.description: Anatomical containment from Uberon, a multi-species anatomy ontology. Each edge encodes one `part_of` assertion linking a part structure to the whole structure that contains it. The relationship carries no source-specific annotation beyond its existence.
